title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
**ORACLE — EVENING BRIEF**

Bitcoin closed at $75,594, down 2.1% but holding critical support. This dip masks the real story: institutional accumulation is accelerating. BlackRock and peers are stacking aggressively—a signal we're entering a major phase-in.

Network fundamentals scream strength. Hashrate locked at 1,035 exahashes—nearly peak—proving Bitcoin's defense is bulletproof. Market dominance holding firm as corporates pile in.

Fear gauge sits at 27. That's capitulation territory. Histor
